servers.name: mcp-playwright
args: set -eu; CID=$(cat /etc/hostname); SRC=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/opt/omni"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$CID"); [ -n "$SRC" ] || { echo 'playwright-mcp: cannot resolve the host path of /opt/omni' >&2; exit 1; }; PWDIR="$SRC/data/playwright"; ST="$PWDIR/state"; mkdir -p "$ST" "$PWDIR/output"; SF="$ST/${PW_STATE_FILE:-sessions.json}"; [ -f "$SF" ] || printf '{"cookies":[],"origins":[]}' > "$SF"; env | grep '^PW_SECRET_' | sed 's/^PW_SECRET_//' > "$ST/secrets.env" || true; [ -s "$ST/secrets.env" ] || rm -f "$ST/secrets.env"; PWUID="${PW_UID:-1000}"; if chown -R "$PWUID:$PWUID" "$PWDIR" 2>/dev/null; then chmod 700 "$PWDIR" "$ST" 2>/dev/null || true; chmod 600 "$SF" 2>/dev/null || true; chmod 600 "$ST/secrets.env" 2>/dev/null || true; else chmod 755 "$PWDIR" "$ST" 2>/dev/null || true; chmod 644 "$SF" 2>/dev/null || true; chmod 644 "$ST/secrets.env" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; if [ -f "$ST/secrets.env" ]; then SEC='--secrets=/pw/state/secrets.env'; else SEC=''; fi; exec docker run -i --rm --init --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway -v "$PWDIR":/pw mcr.microsoft.com/playwright/mcp --headless --browser chromium --no-sandbox --isolated --output-dir=/pw/output --storage-state="/pw/state/${PW_STATE_FILE:-sessions.json}" $SEC --timeout-action=10000 --timeout-navigation=30000
